title: Writes a 6-part feature guide for validating a persona with verified CLI flags
task_input: Write a user guide section explaining how to validate an Office AI persona using personas/validate_persona.py --all --check.

rubric.criterion: Uses the 6-part guide pattern (What it is -> Set up -> Step by step -> Expected result -> Tips -> Common mistakes)
rubric.check: Section 2 includes all six guide parts

rubric.criterion: Documents exact stdlib command python -I personas/validate_persona.py without inventing pip packages

failing_example.output: Run the validator script to check your files.
failing_example.why_it_fails: Omits exact CLI syntax, expected output, common mistakes, and the 4-section contract.
